# Radoslav Radev Advises Having A Structure To Track Results But Also Listening To Your Body

Radoslav Radev advises having a structure to track your results but also listening to your body, because if you push yourself 100% on a day that your body is not ready, you are not going to make progress. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:02]

## Details

- Tracking results is important because without it you do not know if you are on the right path, when to go to the next progression, or if your technique is getting better or worse. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 05:04]
- On days when the plan says push yourself 100 but you start the workout and feel heavy and the chance to beat your record is zero on these days, do not follow the program blindly. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 05:27]
- On those days do a lighter session: focus on technique, fix a bad habit, use a resistance band, do a different variation, or some balance work like handstand. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 05:38]
- Pushing yourself 100% on a day that your body is not ready means you are not going to make progress. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:02]

## Evidence

- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 05:04 (Radoslav Radev): "rule number four have a structure to track your results but also listen your body and guys tracking your results is really really important if you don't track your results you don't know if you're on the right path or no"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 05:27 (Radoslav Radev): "there will be days that your plan says push yourself 100 but you're starting the workout you're trying the first attempt and you're feeling so heavy and the chance to beat your record is zero on these days don't follow the program blindly"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 05:38 (Radoslav Radev): "do a lighter session focus on your technique again trying to fix something in your technique like a bad habit that you're doing or you can do resistant band or other variation of the skill maybe some balance work some handstand or something like this"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 06:02 (Radoslav Radev): "if you push yourself 100% on a day that your body is not ready, you are not going to make progress. And by the way, it's possible to target your nervous system and again to lose progress."
